104:924.en: 「$$テッサ$$ said it's fine!\nI'm showing no mercy!」

104:1020.en: 「Don't drag the world and others\ninto your selfish logic!」

104:1754.en: 「The only goddess I need is ours!」

104:1836.en: 「No, no, no, no! Shut the hell up!」

104:1967.en: 「I'll savor the best part at the end!」

104:2157.en: 「Time to get off Earth, right now!」

104:2253.en: 「Like I'd listen to a self-proclaimed\nemissary of God!」

104:2302.en: 「Let's show this phony god\nwhat humans are made of!」

104:2351.en: 「I'll show you my ace in the hole...!」

104:2525.en: 「See $$ミスリル$$'s best sniper at work!」

104:2604.en: 「Let me show you a godlike shot!」

104:2852.en: 「Hey, pal! It's too soon to leave!」

104:3192.en: 「Gotta show sis how cool I am!」

104:3334.en: 「$$葵$$! You owe me a reward later!」

104:3507.en: 「A hot kiss is thanks enough, $$テッサ$$!」

104:3719.en: 「$$キリコ$$! You're pushing it too far!」

104:3754.en: 「Hands off $$葵$$, $$くらら$$, and $$エイーダ$$!」

104:4041.en: 「I'll make sure I get my share!」

104:4107.en: 「So we pick them off one by one!」
alternatives: We'll take them down one by one!

104:4229.en: 「I'll try a quick draw for once!」

104:4533.en: 「You're so easy to read. Got it?」

104:4603.en: 「Whew! I'm in love with myself again!」

104:4646.en: 「Nailed it like an action movie star!」

104:4765.en: 「I know exactly what you're up to!」

104:4804.en: 「Tch! You think this is a game?!」

104:4843.en: 「That kind of thing won't work on me!」

104:4987.en: 「Nothing I can do if it hit me.」

104:5125.en: 「No resistance at all! I'm let down!」

104:5479.en: 「Damn! Look at the state I'm in...!」

104:5652.en: 「That's no way to reject my advances!」

104:5695.en: 「So this is the end of the line...!」

104:5786.en: 「I hate to say it,\nbut this is bad!」

104:5966.en: 「All I need is a working gun...!」

104:6050.en: 「Damn it!\nWhat a lame way to go...!」

104:6236.en: 「Easy on games, and on studying too!」

104:6356.en: 「So, how about a movie to unwind?」

104:6529.en: 「I'm gone! Cover for me! See ya!」

104:6629.en: 「$$ロックオン$$, bro shoots better. I'm No.1?」

104:6792.en: 「Ha ha! We think alike, don't we!」

104:7216.en: 「I'll make Sis fall for me again!」

104:7598.en: 「$$アマルガム$$! Time to repay the debt!」

104:7664.en: 「Hey, at least show who you are!」

104:7703.en: 「Damn, there's no end to this, huh!」

104:7779.en: 「Can't let a single one\nslip past my guns!」

104:8059.en: 「Messing with Earth?\nYou've got a death wish!」

104:8108.en: 「Go back to the star you came from!」

104:8141.en: 「So what if you've got a $$スフィア$$?!」

104:8180.en: 「Reactor, tractor, whatever!\nI don't give a damn!」

104:8239.en: 「$$欲深な金牛$$, huh...!\nWhat a greedy, spoiled body!」

104:8372.en: 「Emissary of a god or not,\nyou can't escape my aim!」

104:8427.en: 「I can't bring myself to believe\nin gods like you!」

104:8515.en: 「A smiling swindler\nis impossible to deal with!」

104:8599.en: 「Don't get cocky just because\nyou've got backing, punk!」

104:8660.en: 「Hey, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nI'll freeze that smirk right off!」

104:8723.en: 「I'll do it for the woman I love too!」

104:9323.en: 「$$宗介$$, greet the players. That's an order.」
